address.streetAddress: 台北市中山區北安路621巷17號1樓 Taipei

hasMenuItem.name: 經典美式 Classic Americano
hasMenuItem.description:
無糖。不提供糖包以及加糖服務。
可依據喜好選擇咖啡豆：
。果酸清爽感：中淺焙（初韻配方）
。可可苦韻感：中深焙（薇薇特南果）

Sugar-free. Sugar bags and sugaring services are not provided.

You can choose coffee beans according to your preferences:
. Medium-Light roasting (First Note Blend)
. Medium-Dark roasting ( Huehuetenango )

hasMenuItem.name: 經典拿鐵 Classic Latte
hasMenuItem.description:
無糖。不額外提供加糖與糖包服務。

鮮奶與咖啡融合，突顯咖啡濃郁堅果香氣。
Sugar-free. No additional sugar and sugar package services are provided.
The combination of fresh milk and coffee highlights the rich nutty aroma of coffee.

hasMenuItem.name: 青雲拿鐵 [抹茶] Matcha Latte
hasMenuItem.description:
使用福岡八女抹茶，濃郁微苦的抹茶，搭配少許台灣在地小農頂級龍眼蜜，層次豐富融合！
Using Fukuoka Yame Matcha, rich and slightly bitter matcha, with a little Taiwan's local small farmer's top longan honey, rich layers of integration!

hasMenuItem.name: 火岩拿鐵 [焙茶] Hojicha Latte
hasMenuItem.description:
使用台灣焙茶，炭焙香味微弱苦感，搭配少許台灣在地小農頂級龍眼蜜，提升焙茶香氣與甜味，融合咖啡更佳濃郁！
Using Taiwan Hojicha , the charcoal roasting fragrance is weak and bitter, with a little Taiwan's local small farmer's top longan honey, to improve the aroma and sweetness of roasted tea, and combine coffee to make it richer!

hasMenuItem.name: 蘋果肉桂拿鐵  Cinnamon Latte with Apple
黑泡美式  Cola Americano
焦糖脆脆拿鐵  Caramel Crunch Latte

手工自製香脆椪糖，是一款融合香甜焦糖與濃郁咖啡, 享受生活苦中帶甜的樂趣。
Handmade crispy candy is a combination of sweet caramel and rich coffee, and you can enjoy the bittersweet joy of life.

hasMenuItem.name: 金麥蜂釀美式  Honey with Hop Americano
hasMenuItem.description:
{ 人氣NO.1 } 清爽蜜香中藏著淡淡麥香，綿密泡沫搭配自製椪糖，是一款清爽香甜的咖啡特調！！
{ TOP 1 } There is a faint wheat fragrance hidden in the refreshing honey fragrance, and the dense foam is matched with self-made sugar, which is a refreshing and sweet coffee special!!
